messages:
alex_support: Escalating to CS — Skylark (trial) reporting repeated timeouts + degraded latency on embeddings during their final integration tests. Customer says this is blocking go/no-go for pilot. Marked P1.

alex_support: Repro summary: client-initiated bulk ingest (~5k docs) via streaming endpoint. After ~90s many requests time out or return 502. Sample: `HTTP 502 {\"error\":\"gateway_timeout\"}`. No code deploys at the time.

zoe_cs: Thanks Alex. Primary contact is rachel@skylark.ai, trial ends 2026-07-02. Conversion meeting tentatively scheduled 2026-07-07; this needs urgent attention. I can run the customer bridge if eng can join.

paul_csm: I want a quick comms plan: A) acknowledge + apologies, B) short workaround they can apply, C) timeline for engineering patch, D) offer a temporary concierge run to finish tests. We should avoid promising changes to SLA without eng confirmation.

marta_eng: Looking at metrics — gateway queue saturation + slow tail latencies. Kernel-level memory metrics show sustained high KV-cache churn. Hypothesis: client used large concurrent streams causing cache thrash. Quick mitigation: reduce client parallelism, use batch async, or enable tenant-level rate smoothing. I can validate in 4h.

alex_support: Proposed immediate message to customer: "Were investigating intermittent timeouts affecting your ingest. Short-term: please limit parallel streams to 3 and switch to the async batch endpoint while we validate. We can also enable a one-time quota uplift. We'll follow up with a technical update within 24 hours." Agree?

zoe_cs: Sounds good. Add: confirm the bridge time within 2h and offer a written runbook snippet. Also I'll note renewal risk in their record and offer a one-week extended pilot if they want reassurance.

scale-bot: autoscaler: no automatic scale event recorded during incident window. Recommend manual headroom increase.

marta_eng: I'll try a targeted canary with `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8` and a gateway smoothing knob for tenant skylark. If it reduces 502s in staging, we can apply a 6-hour prod canary. ETA: 6h for staging validation, 18-24h for cautious production roll.

paul_csm: For the customer bridge agenda: 1) quick acknowledgement + who is on call, 2) immediate workaround + how-to (zoe/alex), 3) engineering plan + ETA (marta), 4) next steps and offer (paul). Zoe — can you schedule a 30-min bridge today?

zoe_cs: Scheduled 30-min bridge with Rachel for 2026-06-15 08:30 PT. Invited @marta_eng, @alex_support, @paul_csm. I'll send the runbook and the proposed wording now.

alex_support: Runbook snippet for customer: 
```
# recommended for large imports
EXPORT CONCURRENCY=3
USE_ASYNC_BATCH=true
BACKOFF_INITIAL_MS=200
BACKOFF_MAX_MS=5000
```
Plus example async call: `curl -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings/async -d @batch.json -H \"Authorization: Bearer <key>\"`

marta_eng: Starting staging canary now. If successful I'll prepare a controlled prod window and coordinate with ops to bump headroom manually for 6h.

paul_csm: Action items recap: (1) send customer runbook + schedule bridge (zoe) due 30m, (2) eng validate canary + prod plan (marta) due 6h, (3) ops temporary headroom if canary green (marta/scale-bot) ongoing, (4) CSM note including renewal mitigation offer (paul) due after bridge. Keep thread updates concise.

alex_support: Update 2026-06-15T10:05Z — after applying concurrency limits and switching to async path, Skylark completed 70% of tests and paused retries. Customer appreciated fast response but asked for firm timeline before the conversion call.

marta_eng: Staging canary indicates 85% reduction in 502s with `KV_CACHE_LIMIT=0.8` and gateway smoothing. I'll prep prod canary and post a short RCA draft to this thread after rollout.

zoe_cs: Post-bridge: Rachel accepted the temporary uplift and asked for the RCA before the pilot kickoff. I scheduled a post-rollout check for 2026-06-16 09:00 PT. Also logged renewal-risk flag and offered one-week extension.

paul_csm: Great response. Please paste the final RCA + proposed long-term changes (trial guardrails, improved onboarding docs, telemetry for retry storms) into this thread so we can attach to the renewal playbook.

marta_eng: Will post RCA and remediation plan within 48h.

alex_support: Closing loop: customer currently stable; will report final completion after prod canary.
